deck.title: Harbor Desk: a fictional team onboarding demo

cards.title: Welcome to Harbor Desk
cards.body: Harbor Desk is a fictional product used only for this demonstration. Learn a six-step onboarding workflow, try approved local resources and return to the presentation safely.

cards.title: What you will practise
cards.body: Navigate a short briefing, estimate a training budget, open a reference and resource folder, bookmark a question, and recover from an unavailable resource. All prices and product claims are invented.

cards.title: Your example team
cards.body: A fictional team has eight new colleagues. Each person needs two training sessions. No real employee, customer or company information is used.

cards.title: Estimate the training budget
cards.body: Each fictional session costs 15 credits per person. Open Calculator and calculate 8 × 2 × 15 = 240 credits. Return to GestureForge and explicitly resume. Opening Calculator alone does not complete the task.

cards.title: Find the onboarding reference
cards.body: Open the locally bound product reference. Find the fictional escalation contact: the training coordinator. Return, resume and acknowledge that you found the answer.

cards.title: Locate the resource folder
cards.body: Open the locally bound demo resource folder. Find corporate_reference.txt. Return and resume. The shared workspace stores a semantic resource slot; each computer chooses its own folder.

cards.title: Save a discussion point
cards.body: Bookmark this card for later discussion. Repeating BOOKMARK must keep one bookmark. Use the bookmark review list to return to it after the demonstration.

cards.title: Recover without guessing
cards.body: The evaluator will make a dedicated test reference unavailable. Attempt to open it, read the failure message and use the manual retry or rebind path. Do not delete or rename genuine user files.

cards.title: Pause, save and resume
cards.body: Pause and reload the demo. Check the saved position and bookmark. Gesture control must remain paused and no resource may reopen automatically. Resume explicitly and show NEUTRAL before another command.

cards.title: Review the session
cards.body: Review completed steps, launch requests, failures and retries. A launch request is not proof of task completion. Discuss one recognition limitation and the manual alternative.

stages.title: Welcome
stages.instructions: Explain the fictional Harbor Desk purpose. Browse the outcomes and team cards, then continue.

stages.title: Training budget
stages.instructions: Open Calculator, calculate 8 × 2 × 15 = 240 credits. Return, explicitly resume, then acknowledge the actual answer.

stages.title: Product reference
stages.instructions: Open the locally bound reference. Find the fictional training coordinator, return and acknowledge the result.

stages.title: Resource folder
stages.instructions: Open the local resource folder. Find corporate_reference.txt. Return, explicitly resume and acknowledge completion.

stages.title: Discussion and recovery
stages.instructions: Bookmark this point once. Attempt the unavailable disposable reference, rebind or restore it and retry. Pause, save and restore: remain paused with no launch replay. Never move genuine user files.

stages.title: Session review
stages.instructions: Review simulated triggers, real launch requests, failures, retries and explicit acknowledgements. Explain one recognition limitation and the manual fallback.
